cases.title: A History at the Basic level: three of four deals, one holder key, one anchor
cases.source: responder

cases.title: One step's kind changed in an artifact in transit
cases.source: derived: history-1's failed step made completed in its artifact after signing, not re-signed

cases.title: A deal added to the definition the recipient holds
cases.source: derived: the run's replies, under a definition with one more deal

cases.title: An envelope, signed by the holder key, for a deal not selected
cases.source: responder

cases.title: A selected deal not answered
cases.source: derived: the run's replies for deals 1 and 2 only

cases.title: One deal answered under a second key the relying party also trusts

cases.title: One deal answered at another anchor, as its request named
cases.source: responder

cases.title: One deal answered at another anchor, against a request naming the History's anchor
cases.source: derived: the other-anchor envelope re-signed by the holder key over history-3's request digest

cases.title: A record kind outside §3, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: history-1's second record_type changed, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: A record carrying a member outside reads, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: counterparty_ref added to history-1's first record, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: A definition whose reads adds statement and counterparty_ref
cases.source: responder

cases.title: An Artifact that is not exactly JCS, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: a space added after the opening brace in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: An entry digest that is not a digest, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: the first record's digest in uppercase hex in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: An entry leaf_index given as text, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: the first record's leaf_index as text in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: A read member holding an object, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: the first record's committed_at replaced by an object in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: A committed_at with fractional seconds, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: the first record's committed_at given with fractional seconds in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: An event_time_claim with a UTC offset in place of Z, re-signed by the holder key
cases.source: derived: the first record's event_time_claim given as +00:00 in history-1's artifact, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: An epistemic_type outside EL §4.1, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: Three deals in three streams, one holder key, one witnessed checkpoint tick

cases.title: Three deals in three streams, one answered at its stream's own checkpoint
cases.source: derived: multi-stream-one-tick with history-3 requested and answered at its stream's checkpoint, re-signed by the holder key

cases.title: Three deals in three streams at one anchor tick, one committed through an earlier tick with its tick path

cases.title: The same, with the tick path's consistency proof changed
cases.source: derived: multi-stream-earlier-tick with one octet of the consistency proof's last right peak flipped
